keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's Ryazan shape of 1453-1501, 17,026 km2 (72 cells), kept as drawn. It holds Ryazan itself, Zaraysk, Mikhailov and Skopin (a gazetteer test, not a page) and leaves out Kolomna (taken by Moscow after 1301: 'Daniel defeated Ryazan in 1301, after which Kolomna and Serpukhov were incorporated into the Moscow principality', Moscow page) and Murom ('Murom was taken by Moscow in 1392', Ryazan page). PRONSK (repaired 2026-10-31): Pronsk stands at 54 07 N 39 37 E on the Pronya (Pronsk, Pronsky District page), inside the shape's bounding box (38.54-40.51E, 53.53-55.70N); a 40 km disc at that site has 16 of its 20 cells in this shape and 4 in Cliopatria's Qasim Khanate shape of 1483. The first version of this dossier put the town at 53.95N 40.85E, about 80 km too far east, and wrote that 'Pronsk lies outside' the shape; that was wrong. The Ryazan page calls it 'its provincial Pronsk Principality' in conflict with Ryazan 'until Ryazan completely annexed Pronsk in 1483', and the Pronsk page has it as the town that 'long rivaled Pereslavl-Ryazansky ... for importance in the Principality of Ryazan', so this dossier reads Pronsk as already inside Ryazan's land: the shape is kept unchanged for 1453-1501 (the keyframe ryazan_1483, which added a disc, is dropped) and the 1483 event records the end of Pronsk's separate principality, not new ground. The infobox gives no area, so the factor-of-two check against Cliopatria cannot be made (unverified: the page budget has no page with a figure).

Cliopatria 17,389 km2, +2.1% on 1453 (bbox edges move by 0.02 and 0.07 degrees): no border move is dated by any page opened. Pronsk lies inside the shape as in 1453 (16 of the 20 cells of a 40 km disc at the true site). The infobox gives no area, so the factor-of-two check against Cliopatria cannot be made (unverified: the page budget has no page with a figure).

wars.name: Muscovite takeover of the Principality of Ryazan
wars.outcome: Vasili III summoned Ivan V of Ryazan to Moscow in 1517, captured and imprisoned him in 1520 and merged the principality with Muscovy in 1521; no battle is recorded on the pages opened.
wars.note: The pages disagree on Ivan V: the Ryazan page has Vasili III imprisoning him in Moscow in 1520 and 'Prince Ivan Ivanovich fled into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania' in 1521; the Vasili III page has him summoned in 1517, tonsured and imprisoned in a monastery, with Vasili taking 'his inheritance for himself in 1521'. No zone is listed because no fighting over land is dated, so there are no contest events.

notes: Page budget 5 (Principality of Ryazan, Ryazan, Principality of Moscow, Ivan III, Vasili III), all opened 2026-10-31. SAME STATE AS principality-of-ryazan (Wikidata Q269109; one Wikipedia article, 1129-1521): kept as two dossiers because the earlier row belongs to another batch and a unilateral merge would give two dossiers the same shapes; to merge, move this file's keyframes into principality-of-ryazan and run its end to 1521. Cliopatria has no Ryazan shape for 1241-1452: the principality continued under the Horde (page: Daniel of Moscow took Ryazan in 1301 and Kolomna passed to Moscow; Skornishchevo 1371; Oleg II at Kulikovo 1380; an unbroken ruler list from 1301), but none of the pages opened gives its extent in those 212 years, so no keyframe is invented; the first Cliopatria shape (1453) is the dossier's start. Whoever merges the dossiers should add a confidence-1 keyframe for 1241-1452 from the 1453 shape. Not settled: (1) the Ryazan infobox gives no area, so the 17,000 km2 of Cliopatria cannot be compared (Ryazan Oblast alone is about 40,000 km2 by the gazetteer; the shape covers 46 of its 159 cells plus 22 of Moscow Oblast); (2) whether Kasimov (Qasim Khanate, Cliopatria 1453-1520, adjacent) or Zaraysk/Kolomna were Ryazan's in 1453-1521 is not on any page opened; (3) Pronsk's extent (REPAIRED: no disc is drawn any more, see the repair paragraph); (4) the pages disagree on whether Ivan V was imprisoned (1520, 1517) or fled to Lithuania (1521); (5) Cliopatria's Moscow shape already holds the Ryazan cells in 1521 (Moscow 2,416,195 km2 in 1519-1520 to 2,433,401 in 1521, +17,206 km2), so 1521 is drawn twice if this dossier runs to 1521; end it at 1520 if the renderer cannot take the overlap. The Ivan III page does not mention Ryazan. Gazetteer names needed: Pronsk (place, 54.117N 39.617E; the dossier uses its coordinates for the 1483 event). Counterparts: grand-principality-of-moscow, principality-of-ryazan have dossiers; 'Principality of Pronsk' is named as the source gives it (a minor appanage, no dossier proposed). REPAIR 2026-10-31 (reviewer finding of review-eu-16-g): the 'Pronsk' disc of the first version was centred at 40.85E 53.95N (near Sapozhok), about 80 km east of Pronsk (54 07 N 39 37 E, Pronsk page); it shared no cell with Cliopatria's Ryazan shape and 14 with its Qasim Khanate shape of 1483, and the keyframe note 'Pronsk lies outside' was false: a 40 km disc at the true site has 16 of 20 cells inside Cliopatria's Ryazan shape. Reading chosen: Pronsk was Ryazan's own 'provincial Pronsk Principality' (Ryazan page) and the town that 'long rivaled Pereslavl-Ryazansky ... for importance in the Principality of Ryazan' (Pronsk page), i.e. inside Ryazan's land, so the union is dropped from every keyframe, the shapes are kept as Cliopatria draws them (ryazan_1453 now covers 1453-1501 again; the added keyframe ryazan_1483 is removed), the 1483 gain is kept as a consolidation of the part of the shape that is Pronsk's (confidence 2) and the 1521 loss, the dissolve and the successor land are Cliopatria's 1519 shape alone. The alternative reading, that Pronsk was a separate state 1453-1482, would need a hole in the 1453 shape; the pages do not support it. NOT done (thin, undated on the pages): the Horde and Moscow vassal relations (Ivan III of Ryazan 'renounced his allegiance to Golden Horde' within 1427-1456, Vasily III 'an ally of Moscow', Ivan IV 'swore allegiance to Ivan III of Russia' within 1483-1500, 'Ryazan later became dependent on Moscow'): no year is given, and golden-horde.json carries a 1453 territorial loss to Ryazan that is a Cliopatria artefact.
